result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but one visible text truncation defect stands out: the restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' is clipped mid-character to 'Tokumaru Ramei' despite ample empty space remaining before the rating on the same row.

issues.description: The restaurant title in the 'Popular right now' section reads 'Tokumaru Ramei' — the final letter(s) of 'Ramen' are clipped mid-glyph with no ellipsis, even though there is plenty of whitespace between the title and the 4.8 rating on the right.
issues.suggestion: Fix the title container's width constraint or max-width so the full name renders; if truncation is genuinely needed, apply proper ellipsis truncation (text-overflow: ellipsis) instead of hard clipping mid-character.
